pairs.subject: packaging
pairs.evidence: package.json:26 The matrix-grid context is browser UI served by a Next.js server process (`next start`), and nothing installs it on a desktop. I searched the context's directory, including focus/, for installer, codesign, signtool, electron, notariz and tauri and got zero hits. The repo tracks no electron-builder, tauri.conf, .wxs, .nsi or forge.config file, so the subject's precondition (a desktop application installed on machines you never touch) does not hold here.
